referenceMaterial.summary: Never execute full wild-card purges. Use content-hashed immutable URLs (e.g. app.bundle.a8f9c2.js) so new deployments never invalidate existing caches, and warm critical paths before traffic cutover . Invariant: "Deploy immutable content-hashed assets and avoid blunt full-cache purges to protect origin infrastructure."
approachSteps: 1. Ingress Boundary Defense: Never execute full wild-card purges. Use content-hashed immutable URLs (e.g. app.bundle.a8f9c2.js) so new deployments never invalidate existing caches
2. Failure Containment: Eliminate unconstrained buffering and propagate physical backpressure.
3. Invariant Enforcement: Deploy immutable content-hashed assets and avoid blunt full-cache purges to protect origin infrastructure.
referenceMaterial.diagramDescription: Ingress → Bounded Admission Controller → Adaptive Concurrency / Queue Gate → Protected Worker Engine; Overload Shed Path → HTTP 429 / Circuit Fallback (<0.1ms).

referenceMaterial.summary: Failure physics analysis: 100k QPS → TTL Expiration → Cache Miss Herd → Origin Slam → 💥 DB Meltdown.
failureModes: Cascading Failure: Every edge location purges its entire static asset and API cache simultaneously. The next wave of 500,000 global user requests penetrates directly to origin load balancers, crashing backend servers in 2 seconds.
Breakdown Chain: 100k QPS → TTL Expiration → Cache Miss Herd → Origin Slam → 💥 DB Meltdown
Shedding Failure: Without fast rejection at the boundary, queued dead work triggers multi-second GC pauses, CPU thrashing, and cascading 504 Gateway Timeouts.
